```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(readr)

# Read the file as a CSV
survey_data <- read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE)
# Preview the first 6 rows
head(survey_data)

```

```{r}
#Get a overview of the dataset:
glimpse(survey_data)
anyNA(survey_data)
miss_var_summary(survey_data)
nrow(survey_data)
ncol(survey_data)

```

```{r}
# Reshape the data from wide to long format
skills_long <- survey_data %>%
  # Keep respondent info plus all "...HaveWorkedWith" skill columns
  # (e.g., LanguageHaveWorkedWith, DatabaseHaveWorkedWith)
  select(ResponseId, DevType,YearsCodePro,
         ends_with("HaveWorkedWith"))%>%
    # Stack all the skill columns into two columns:
  # skill_category (the original column name) and skill (the value)

  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("HaveWorkedWith"),
    names_to = "skill_category",
    values_to = "skill"
  ) %>%
    # Drop rows where the respondent left the skill answer blank

  filter(!is.na(skill)) %>%
  # Each skill cell holds multiple skills separated by ";"
  # (e.g., "Python;SQL;R"), so split them into one skill per row

  # separate_rows(skill, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    # Clean category names by removing the "HaveWorkedWith" suffix
    # (e.g., "LanguageHaveWorkedWith" becomes "Language")
    skill_category = str_remove(skill_category, "HaveWorkedWith"),
        # Remove any leading/trailing whitespace from skill names

    skill = str_trim(skill)
  )
# Display the reshaped data

print(skills_long)
# Check the structure of the new long-format dataset
  
glimpse(skills_long)


```

```{r}
# Returns TRUE if any NA exists anywhere in the dataset

anyNA(skills_long)
# Total count of NA values across all columns

sum(is.na(skills_long))
# List the names of columns that contain at least one NA

skills_long %>%
  select(where(~ any(is.na(.x)))) %>%
  names()
# Summary table of missing values per variable (count and percentage)

miss_var_summary(skills_long)

```

```{r}
skills_long <- skills_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(DevType))

```

```{r}
# Re-check for missing values after filtering on DevType

anyNA(skills_long)
sum(is.na(skills_long))
```
